sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.

sources.snippet: Supertonic is a lightning-fast, on-device multilingual text-to-speech system designed for local inference with minimal overhead. Powered by ONNX Runtime, it runs entirely on your device—no cloud, no API calls, no privacy concerns.

sources.title: supertonic_3/README.md at main · 1nk1/supertonic_3 · GitHub
sources.snippet: At about 99M parameters across the public ONNX assets, Supertonic 3 is much smaller than 0.7B to 2B class open TTS systems. The smaller model size is a practical advantage for download size, startup time, and on-device inference.

sources.title: Supertonic 3: On-Device Text-to-Speech with ONNX Runtime for CPU
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M parameter, CPU-only TTS model running via ONNX Runtime that supports 31 languages, outputs 44.1kHz 16-bit WAV, and installs with pip install supertonic. Strong on standard text and multilingual sentences; struggles with currency and complex number formatting without additional text normalization.
